# Offline Exit Controls

These are list-independent control crops from the authorized 2026-10-11 shopping
run, not a new live test. The pending frame was captured during purchase loading;
the settled frame was captured later, showing the zero total after purchase.

- Header `(584,53,695,94)`: shop emblem, LOCAL tab and batch switch only.
- Footer `(1000,646,264,48)`: selection total and purchase button.
- Navigation `(0,0,270,80)`: return and train buttons.

No player UID, currency header or inventory artwork is retained. Tests combine
these patches with black synthetic surroundings. Rest-menu and departure evidence
reuse separately documented actual control crops from existing fixtures. Offline
recognition does not prove the exit clicks work in a running client.
